decision.message: Sending measurements over Wi-Fi is unsupported because the radios must be disabled in the esp32_bmp280_v1 board family as per the capability context.

clauses.text: Make this pressure node send measurements over Wi-Fi.
clauses.reason: The request to send measurements over Wi-Fi requires enabling the ESP32 radio, but wireless/RF performance is not qualified and radios must be disabled in this board family.
Bluetooth support is explicitly not needed, which does not conflict with any board capabilities, so it is supported as an exclusion.
